notes: The prepared projection already carries the chapter's decisions for WLC.EZK.42.9.v001 and v002; nothing textual is decided here (rule 9).
*was* is placed on the fronted מִתַּחַת as the clause's prepositional predicate (rule 49); the competing reading, noted in the unit, gives it to the participle subject *the entry*.
מִתַּחַת is split rather than fused, because *from* and *under* each render one morpheme and rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
Both articles in מִתַּחַת הַלְּשָׁכוֹת הָאֵלֶּה are unrepresented, exactly as rule 29's הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה → *these cities*.
